name: pleaseup-hotspots
description: Add drag & drop hotspots to images from the Media Library, Gutenberg galleries, and ACF fields.

scripts.build:css: sass --no-source-map --style=compressed assets/src/css/admin.scss assets/dist/css/admin.min.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed assets/src/css/frontend.scss assets/dist/css/frontend.min.css
scripts.build:js: terser assets/src/js/admin.js -o assets/dist/js/admin.min.js -c -m && terser assets/src/js/admin-gallery.js -o assets/dist/js/admin-gallery.min.js -c -m && terser assets/src/js/frontend.js -o assets/dist/js/frontend.min.js -c -m
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.watch:js: echo 'Use a JS bundler in watch mode if needed'
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
